snippet.title: Fall of Gorithia - Nym's Fate | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Fall of Gorithia: Nym's Fate is a 2D action adventure set in the ancient land of Gorithia. Go from simple thief to magic wielding warrior as you battle your way through hordes of parasitic mutants and explore the fallen kingdom on your quest to find your lost brother in this sprawling fantasy world.

Playtesting and demo will be available soon! Wishlist on Steam or join or Discord to keep yourself updated.

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3059800/Fall_of_Gorithia_Nyms_Fate/
Discord - https://discord.gg/u5jy9qMMQU 
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/nymsfate
